Class ShopDetailDomainService

java.lang.Object
com.dianping.shopdetail.service.ShopDetailDomainService
public class ShopDetailDomainService extends java.lang.Object
商详联合查询与跨对象业务规则；不依赖任务引擎、HTTP 或持久化框架。
